conventions.hold: MEDIAN of the 20 pre-onset ticks (mean is contaminated by the 3-4 tick preview lead); y/r baseline = mean of first 15 pre ticks
conventions.cap_frac: fraction of (tick, active pair) samples >= 29.5 uA over the window

mpc.note: 1.00 is expected for deterministic tapes and a deterministic controller driven by a fixed per-site template: decodability is inherited from the reference, it is not evidence of a site-specific stimulation strategy. Use between_site correlations for that question.
